result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to a roadway with parallel parking on both sides. Significant obstructions from trash bags on the right walkway and a lack of marked crossings or traffic calming measures reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trash bags are placed directly on the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to step into the street or squeeze past.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks at the nearest intersections to provide designated safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses built directly to the sidewalk edge. The pedestrian environment is functional but lacks a buffer from traffic and contains minor sidewalk obstructions and uneven pavement.

hazards.description: An orange plastic barrier is placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, in front of the brown house

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk has patches and cracks that could present a tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles block the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous walking surface free of tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters where space allows to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or mid-block access points to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to row houses, with significant obstructions like trash bags forcing pedestrians into the roadway. The environment lacks marked crossings, traffic calming, or lane markings, creating a reliance on informal shared space between vehicles and people.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Large trash bags placed on the narrow sidewalk on the left side of the street block the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Pedestrians in Roadway
hazards.description: A pedestrian is walking in the center of the travel lane, likely due to sidewalk obstructions or lack of clear pedestrian priority.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street limits visibility between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Add speed humps or cushions to physically enforce low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with continuous sidewalks and row-house frontage. The environment lacks a buffer between pedestrians and the roadway, and the presence of litter and uneven pavement presents minor hazards.

hazards.name: Litter and Debris
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and a traffic cone on the sidewalk create tripping hazards and narrow the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The absence of a planting strip or furniture zone leaves pedestrians directly adjacent to the roadway with no physical protection.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire length of the curb line visible in the image.

interventions.title: Green Infrastructure and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to create a physical barrier between the sidewalk and the street, improving safety and comfort.

interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and implement a regular cleaning schedule to ensure a clear, hazard-free walking surface.
